mapper.select: SELECT FROM nw_model_media_jobs WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND id=CAST(#{id} AS bigint)
SELECT FROM nw_model_media_jobs WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND operation_id=#{operation}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nw_model_media_jobs(id,owner_id,tenant_id,operation_id,command_sha256,model_config_id,model_revision, provider_id,service_id,profile_version,model_id,kind,endpoint,credential_encrypted,timeout_seconds, status,reason_code,waiting_stopped,lock_version,created_at,updated_at,input_text,negative_prompt,size, resolution,ratio,voice,language,output_count,video_duration_seconds,speaker_count,seed,prompt_extend, watermark,audio_enabled,diarization,enable_itn) VALUES(CAST(#{r.id} AS bigint),#{r.ownerId},CAST(#{r.tenantId} AS bigint),#{r.operationId},#{r.commandSha256}, CAST(#{r.modelConfigId} AS bigint),#{r.modelRevision},#{r.providerId},#{r.serviceId},#{r.profileVersion},#{r.modelId}, #{r.kind},#{r.endpoint},#{r.credentialEncrypted},#{r.timeoutSeconds},#{r.status},#{r.reasonCode},false,0, #{r.createdAt},#{r.updatedAt},#{r.inputText},#{r.negativePrompt},#{r.size},#{r.resolution},#{r.ratio}, #{r.voice},#{r.language},#{r.outputCount},#{r.videoDurationSeconds},#{r.speakerCount},#{r.seed}, #{r.promptExtend},#{r.watermark},#{r.audioEnabled},#{r.diarization},#{r.enableItn}) ON CONFLICT(owner_id,operation_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE nw_model_media_jobs SET status=#{r.status},provider_request_id=#{r.providerRequestId},provider_task_id=#{r.providerTaskId},reason_code=#{r.reasonCode}, input_tokens=#{r.inputTokens},output_tokens=#{r.outputTokens},image_count=#{r.imageCount},video_count=#{r.videoCount}, characters=#{r.characters},duration_seconds=#{r.durationSeconds},updated_at=#{r.updatedAt},lock_version=lock_version+1 WHERE id=CAST(#{r.id} AS bigint) AND owner_id=#{r.ownerId} AND lock_version=#{expected}
UPDATE nw_model_media_jobs SET waiting_stopped=true,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE id=CAST(#{id} AS bigint) AND owner_id=#{owner}
mapper.select: SELECT id::text,job_id::text,kind,source_encrypted,media_type,size_bytes,sha256,name,available FROM nw_model_media_assets WHERE job_id=CAST(#{job} AS bigint) ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nw_model_media_assets(id,job_id,kind,source_encrypted,media_type,size_bytes,sha256,name,available) VALUES(CAST(#{a.id} AS bigint),CAST(#{a.jobId} AS bigint),#{a.kind},#{a.sourceEncrypted},#{a.mediaType}, #{a.sizeBytes},#{a.sha256},#{a.name},#{a.available})
mapper.update: UPDATE nw_model_media_assets SET media_type=#{mediaType},size_bytes=#{size},sha256=#{sha256},name=#{name},available=true WHERE id=CAST(#{id} AS bigint) AND available=false
